interface.title: SpectraLab · 光谱仪解析系统 (Spectrometer Analysis System) v2.0.0
interface.field: Optical spectroscopy / undergraduate physics lab (diffraction grating spectrometer)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysing measurements after the experiment and writing up the lab report
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn a photo of a diffraction-grating spectrum into a table of calibrated line wavelengths and a ranked list of likely elements, compute the grating constant with its uncertainty from vernier angle readings, and export it all as CSV/JSON or a PNG report.

data.note: Most work used the built-in synthetic example ('载入示例', 2200×640 px). It gives 14 lines. Calibrating against Hg matches 7 of them: R² 0.9999, RMS 0.585 nm. The test file sample.jpg was also uploaded through both '选择图片' and '手机拍照'. It is a 922×15 px continuous rainbow strip, not a real line spectrum. It gave 5 peaks and a weak Hg fit (4 lines matched, RMS 0.953 nm), and its element ranking was unreliable. The self-test bench (lab.html) makes its own synthetic spectra. No real lamp photo was analysed, so element identification was only exercised on synthetic data.

features.name: Spectrum image input with capture tips
features.general: Bring an image into the analysis from a file, a phone camera or a built-in synthetic example, with a short guide on how to take a usable photo
features.specific: 输入 panel: 载入示例, 选择图片, 手机拍照 and the 怎么拍 tips dialog (closed with 知道了)
steps: Open 怎么拍 and read the shooting tips, then press 知道了
Press 选择图片 or 手机拍照 and give a spectrum photo
Or press 载入示例 for a synthetic spectrum
Check that the image and its detected lines appear
serves_tasks: Load a spectrum image to analyse
Read guidance on taking a usable photo

features.name: Image line-profile picker with peak markers
features.general: On an image, choose a horizontal band to average into a 1-D intensity profile, view the profile under the image with detected peaks marked, and inspect peaks by hovering
features.specific: Drag the dashed 剖面行 line on the spectrum photo (or use the slider), set 行宽, see the 剖面 chart with coloured peak dots and 标记 pins, hover for the λ readout, zoom with − / + / ⤢
steps: Drag the dashed profile line onto the bright band (or set 剖面行 %)
Set 行宽 (band width) to average more rows
Read the profile chart and peak markers
Hover a peak for its value; zoom or fit the image
Toggle 剖面 / 标记 overlays
serves_tasks: Choose which strip of the image the brightness profile is taken from
Inspect detected lines on the image and the profile

features.name: Tunable peak detector with live peak table
features.general: Adjust threshold, minimum spacing and smoothing of a 1-D peak finder and watch the peak list update live, trading resolution of close pairs against noise
features.specific: 灵敏度 / 最小间距 / 平滑窗口 sliders update the 谱线 table (x px, λ, relative intensity, colour, best match) and the line count
steps: Raise or lower 灵敏度 (relative height threshold)
Keep 最小间距 small so close pairs stay apart (at 21 px the Hg 577/579 pair merged)
Raise 平滑窗口 for noisy photos, watching for weak lines being lost
Check the 谱线 count and table
serves_tasks: Tune the peak detector until the true lines are found

features.name: Reference-lamp calibration with fit quality card
features.general: Map measured positions to physical units by matching peaks to a known reference line list, with linear or quadratic fit, a manual two-point fallback, and a fit card showing slope, intercept, R², RMS and a fit plot
features.specific: 波长标定: choose 汞/钠/氢/氦 lamp, 自动标定, optional 二次校正, or 手动两点 x₁λ₁ x₂λ₂ → 套用两点标定; 标定 tab shows 色散率 a, 截距 b, R², RMS, a fit plot and how many lines matched from which source; 清除 resets
steps: Pick a reference lamp
Press 自动标定 (optionally tick 二次校正)
Read a, b, R², RMS and the fit plot in 标定
Or type two (pixel, wavelength) pairs and apply
If the fit is poor, recalibrate or press 清除 to discard
serves_tasks: Fit a pixel-to-wavelength calibration against a reference lamp's known lines
Calibrate by hand from two known lines
Judge whether the calibration fit is good enough, and redo or discard it if not

features.name: Library line-matching ranking
features.general: Score each entry of a reference library by how many observed features it explains and how well, and list the candidates ranked, with matched reference lines highlighted
features.specific: 元素 tab: element cards (Hg, Ne, Ar, Ca, Na, …) showing 命中 N · RMS nm and the element's lines as chips, matched ones highlighted green; ranking seen only on synthetic data and not stable between runs
steps: Detect lines
Open the 元素 tab
Read the ranked cards with hit count and RMS
Check which reference lines were matched
serves_tasks: Rank library elements by how many observed lines they match

features.name: Formula calculator with error propagation
features.general: Enter paired instrument readings and parameters, compute a derived constant from a physics formula, and propagate the reading uncertainty into an absolute and relative error
features.specific: 光栅常数: 级次 k, 左/右游标 (°), λ, σθ → 计算 d shows θ=|L−R|/2, d = kλ/sinθ in nm and µm, σd (absolute and relative); it rejects missing readings
steps: Enter order k and wavelength λ
Enter left and right vernier readings
Set the angle uncertainty σθ
Press 计算 d and read d ± σd
Repeat for another line or order to compare
serves_tasks: Compute the grating spacing from the diffraction angle, order and wavelength, with propagated angle uncertainty
Repeat for a second line or order to check consistency

features.name: Results data export
features.general: Download the result table as CSV and the full analysis state (inputs, parameters, fit, derived constant, results, ranking) as JSON
features.specific: 导出 CSV (index, x_px, wavelength_nm, rel_intensity; no colour or match columns) and 导出 JSON in the 谱线 tab
steps: Finish detection and calibration
Press 导出 CSV for the line table
Press 导出 JSON for the full analysis
serves_tasks: Export the line table and full analysis as data files

features.name: One-page report image generator
features.general: Render a one-page report of the analysis with author metadata, preview it, and save it as an image or print it
features.specific: 报告 tab: 实验名称/姓名/学号 → 生成报告图 preview → 保存 PNG or 打印 / 存 PDF
steps: Fill in experiment name, name and student ID
Press 生成报告图 and check the preview
Press 保存 PNG or 打印 / 存 PDF
serves_tasks: Produce a printable one-page lab report

features.name: Synthetic-data validation bench
features.general: Re-test each analysis stage on randomly generated data with known answers, once or in a loop, with a pass/fail summary per suite and an exportable result
features.specific: 检验台 (lab.html): 8 suites (peak recovery, λ calibration, noise robustness, element ID, doublet resolution, grating equation round-trip, sub-pixel accuracy, colour mapping), 跑一次 / 连续 30 轮 / 停止 / 导出结果 JSON
steps: Press 跑一次
Read pass count, pass rate, worst λ error and time
Press 连续 30 轮 for a loop, then 停止
Press 导出结果 JSON
serves_tasks: Run synthetic-data validation of the peak detection, calibration and identification steps

screens_never_reached: 文档 (docs) link: it points to github.com, which is outside the allowed host
The printed or PDF version of the report: 打印 / 存 PDF fires the browser print dialog, which a headless browser does not show
Any detail view for a single 检验台 suite: clicking a suite row did nothing visible
not_done: Did not use the 氦灯 (He) lamp option; Hg, Na and H were tried
Did not drag-and-drop an image onto the dropzone; files were given through the pickers
Did not install the PWA/Service Worker; it is not needed for analysis
Could not judge element identification on a real lamp photo: the only test file (sample.jpg) is a continuous rainbow strip, and its ranking (Ar first) is not meaningful
Did not go back to retune the detector or retake the photo after a poor calibration fit; only switching lamps and 清除 were tried

Dead ends in the grating calculator: pressing 计算 d with both vernier readings empty only prompted to fill them (screens/037.webp); with k=2 and only the left reading 40.9 it was rejected (screens/038.webp)

Observations: in light mode the toasts and the highlighted matched-line chips in 元素 are hard to read; in dark mode they are readable (screens/004.webp vs screens/032.webp). With 二次校正 on, the 标定 cards still label the values 色散率 a / 截距 b but show -0.00000 / 0.11, so the quadratic coefficients are mislabelled (screens/013.webp). After 清除 the 元素 ranking stays, so element matching seems independent of the calibration or the cards are stale. 重置 clears the image but leaves the profile chart and form values (screens/031.webp). A single vernier reading is rejected even though the prompt says an angle can be given directly (screens/038.webp). Clicking an element card does nothing (screens/017.webp).

Replay observations: the 元素 ranking put He (5 hits, RMS 0.96) above an exact Hg fit, and Ne/Kr claimed 4 hits with no highlighted chips (check/screens/014.webp). After 清除 the 标定 tab wrongly said the lines could not be matched to the Hg lamp (check/screens/012.webp). Lowering 最小间距 to 2 px did not split Na 589.0/589.6 on the example (check/screens/004.webp). After stopping the 检验台 loop at round 2 the summary read 5 / 5 instead of out of 8 (check/screens/022.webp). The CSV omits the colour and match columns shown in the table.
